messages.text: Should we renew the dock lease for another five years?
The lease renewal costs 900 credits a year; the harbor board wants an answer by June.
Let us renew the dock lease but ask for a rent cap.
Order two trawl nets from the sailmaker in Brevik.
Two trawl nets with tarred twine come to 340 credits and ship in three weeks.
Draft the crew rota for the autumn herring season.
Week one: Ines and Tomas on the early boat; week two: Ines and Pavel.
The smokehouse flue is cracked, who can repair it?
A mason named Ragna quoted 210 credits to rebuild the flue.
Remind me what documents the annual tax filing needs.
You need the ledger export, the fuel receipts and the signed crew contracts.
What should I cook for the crew lunch on Friday?
Fish stew with rye bread feeds twelve for about 30 credits.
Is Thursday a safe day to sail to the outer reef?
Forecast shows light winds Thursday morning, building by afternoon.
Plan a surprise party for Marta at the old cannery.
Book the cannery hall, order a cake and keep the guest list secret.
Draft our own dock lease renewal letter to the harbor board.
Dear board, we ask to renew the lease at the current rent.
Which spare parts does the diesel engine need before winter?
Order a fuel filter, two impellers and a belt.
